children: Visa authorized a $405 million deposit to its U.S. litigation escrow, triggering reductions in class B‑1, B‑2 and B‑3 conversion rates and as‑converted share counts.
Authorized $405 million deposit to the U.S. litigation escrow under the retrospective responsibility plan, effective Sept 18, 2026.
Conversion rates decreased: B‑1 from 1.5445 to 1.5400, B‑2 from 1.5014 to 1.4924, B‑3 from 1.4953 to 1.4773.
As‑converted share counts fell: B‑1 down ~9,804 to 3,357,351; B‑2 down ~4,377 to 726,311; B‑3 down ~1,089,926 to 89,510,039.
Company notes conversion adjustments have same EPS effect as repurchasing class A stock; calculations used VWAP over Sept 18–22, 2026.
